limits: Instrumented original SDK calls, new process/session per condition, existing project Library and shared OS/shader caches. No empty OS/cache guarantee.
Same-candidate observations, not a matched ordinary-API before/after speedup or precision speed comparison.
CPU process time, submission wall, GPU queue scope intervals, startup/reload/refresh overlap; never add/subtract them into a kernel time.
GPU queue intervals include submitted copies/queue bubbles. Sampling and marker/report overhead affect observed API wall.
Exact-PID timestamped memory counters are observed allocations, not minimum VRAM or guaranteed peaks. Missing intervals remain unavailable.

GPU load/release duration, async managed allocation and explicit Editor index rebuild are not inferred from these timings. Per-reload nested stage rows remain in the hashed raw logs; this compact aggregate exports counts/ranges.
No microphone/public acquisition/native final-candidate interaction is qualified here.
